passwordPolicy: Password must be 8 to 72 characters and include 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 digit, and 1 symbol.

login.headline: Run every pump shift with clarity.
login.intro: Track fuel, credit, cash, inventory, payroll, and compliance from one focused workspace built for petrol pump teams.
login.dailyControlCopy: Keep dips, deliveries, and sales aligned across the site.
login.secureAccessCopy: Role-based workflows for operators, managers, owners, and admins.
login.title: Sign in to PPMS
login.subtitle: Use your registered phone number and password to continue.
login.sessionExpiredBody: You were signed out because your session timed out. Please sign in again.
login.phoneLength: Phone number must be exactly 10 digits

loginErrors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
loginErrors.signInRefused: The server refused this sign-in. Reload the page and try again.
loginErrors.serverProblem: The server had a problem signing you in. Please try again in a few minutes.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: If your account has an email address, enter your registered phone number and we'll send a reset link to it.
forgotPassword.noEmailBody: Staff: ask your pump owner or admin to reset your password. Pump owners: contact the platform administrator. You will choose your own password the next time you sign in.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If this phone number is registered and has an email address on file, we have sent a password reset link. Check your inbox.

resetPassword.invalidLinkBody: This password reset link is invalid or missing a token. Please request a new one from the forgot password page.
resetPassword.title: Set New Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter and confirm your new password below.
resetPassword.success: Password reset successful. Please log in with your new password.
resetPassword.failed: Failed to reset password. The link may have expired.

changePassword.requiredSubtitle: Your password was set by someone else. Enter it as the current password, choose your own, then sign in again.
changePassword.title: Reset Password
changePassword.subtitle: Update your password, then sign in again.
changePassword.mismatch: New password and confirm password must match.
changePassword.requiredSuccess: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

resetPasswordDialog.title: Reset Password
resetPasswordDialog.subtitle: Set a temporary password for {{name}}.
resetPasswordDialog.mismatch: Temporary password and confirm password must match.
resetPasswordDialog.success: Password reset. {{name}} has been signed out everywhere and must choose a new password the next time they sign in. Share the temporary password with them in person.
